doctors.bio: Dr. Suhasini is a BDS-qualified dental surgeon with over 20 years of clinical experience in comprehensive dental care. With a strong focus on patient comfort, precision and personalised treatment, she has helped patients of all ages achieve and keep healthy, confident smiles. Her experience spans routine preventive and restorative care through to advanced dental and surgical procedures. She believes in understanding each patient's needs and treating them with a gentle, ethical, patient-centred approach, and she keeps up with modern advances so every visit is comfortable, transparent and stress-free. Expertise: Comprehensive Dental Care, Preventive Dentistry, Restorative Dentistry, Cosmetic Dentistry, Oral Surgery, Advanced Dental Procedures.
Specialises in the health of the gums and the bone that supports the teeth: gum disease, bleeding gums, deep cleaning and gum surgery.
Handles wisdom-tooth removal, surgical extractions and minor oral surgery, with a focus on safe, comfortable procedures.

doctors._note_qualification: [assumed] in the content file -- confirm at the demo.
doctors.bio: Focuses on saving natural teeth through painless, precise root canal treatment and re-treatment.
Treats wisdom teeth, jaw and facial-bone problems, and performs surgical extractions and implant-site preparation.
Restores missing and damaged teeth with implants, crowns, bridges and dentures designed for comfort and a natural look.
Straightens crooked and protruding teeth with braces and clear aligners for children and adults.

_note_doctorsNotInImporter: The importer does NOT set appointmentDurationMinutes (API default 15) or weekly schedules. Both are applied afterwards via the admin API: PUT /clinics/{id}/doctors/{doctorId} {appointmentDurationMinutes: 30}, then POST /clinics/{id}/doctors/{doctorId}/schedules per day. No photos: initials avatars per the content file.

faqs.question: What are the clinic timings?
faqs.answer: Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM – 2:00 PM and 5:00 PM – 8:00 PM. Saturday, 10:00 AM – 2:00 PM. Closed on Sunday.

faqs.question: How much does treatment cost?
faqs.answer: Consultation required — we'll explain costs before starting any treatment.

faqs.question: Can I book directly with a specialist?
faqs.answer: Yes. Choose the specialist for your concern when you book. If you're not sure who to see, book with Dr. Suhasini and she will guide you.

faqs.question: When are the specialists available?
faqs.answer: Our six consultant specialists see patients Monday to Friday, 5:00 PM – 8:00 PM.

faqs.question: Where is the clinic?
faqs.answer: Aravinda High School Road, Tadepalle, Andhra Pradesh 522501. Call or WhatsApp +91 94414 11629 for directions.

treatments.title: General Dentistry
treatments.description: Dental consultation & check-up · Tooth-coloured fillings · Tooth sensitivity treatment · Emergency toothache care · Children's dental check-ups. With Dr. Suhasini. Consultation required — we'll explain costs before starting.

treatments.title: Root Canal Treatment
treatments.description: Root canal treatment (usually 1–3 sittings) · Re-root canal treatment · Pulp therapy for children's teeth · Crown after root canal (with Dr. Phani). With Dr. Naveen Kumar. Consultation required — we'll explain costs before starting.

treatments.title: Dental Implants
treatments.description: Single-tooth implant (usually 2–3 stages over 3–6 months) · Multiple implants / implant-supported bridge · Full-arch implant solutions · Implant-supported dentures · Bone grafting & sinus lift (oral surgery team). With Dr. Phani. Consultation required — we'll explain costs before starting.

treatments.title: Orthodontics
treatments.description: Metal braces · Ceramic (tooth-coloured) braces · Clear aligners · Retainers · Early orthodontic check for children (7+ years). With Dr. Praveen. Consultation required — we'll explain costs before starting.

treatments.title: Oral & Dental Surgery
treatments.description: Wisdom tooth removal · Surgical & complex extractions · Minor oral surgery (cysts, biopsies) · Jaw & facial bone injury management · Jaw joint (TMJ) pain consultation. With Dr. Varun Krishna, Dr. Preethi and Dr. Suhasini. Consultation required — we'll explain costs before starting.

treatments.title: Oral Hygiene & Prevention
treatments.description: Scaling & polishing · Fluoride application · Pit & fissure sealants for children · Bad-breath (halitosis) care & hygiene counselling. With Dr. Suhasini. Consultation required — we'll explain costs before starting.

treatments.title: Dentures
treatments.description: Complete dentures (usually 4–5 sittings) · Partial dentures · Flexible dentures · Denture repair & relining. With Dr. Phani. Consultation required — we'll explain costs before starting.

treatments.title: Cosmetic Dentistry
treatments.description: Teeth whitening · Smile makeover · Veneers & laminates (Dr. Phani) · Tooth-coloured bonding · Gum contouring (Dr. Sindhu). With Dr. Suhasini and Dr. Phani. Consultation required — we'll explain costs before starting.

treatments.title: Periodontology (Gum Care)
treatments.description: Gum treatment / deep cleaning (scaling & root planing) · Gum surgery (flap surgery) · Gum depigmentation · Crown lengthening · Periodontal maintenance. With Dr. Sindhu. Consultation required — we'll explain costs before starting.
